title: Quantitative imaging of chromatin inheritance using a dual-color histone in Drosophila germinal stem cells
protocol: Use a dual color fluorescence tagged transgenic histone flies.
Employ the UASp-FRT-Histone-EGFP-PolyA-FRT-Histone-mCherry transgene.
Utilize the hs-FLP transgene to induce flippase expression upon heat shock.
Apply the nanos-Gal4 driver for expressing transgenes in GSCs and early-stage germ cells.
Cross UASp-FRT-Histone-EGFP-PolyA-FRT-Histone-mCherry male flies with hs-FLP; nanos-Gal4 female flies.
Maintain fly crosses at 18°C incubator throughout development.
Do not take the flies outside the 18°C incubator once the cross starts.
Collect 1–3-day old adult F1 male progenies in a new vial.
Submerge the vial underneath water up to the plug in a circulating 37°C water bath for 90 min.
Transfer heat-shocked flies into a new vial and recover them in a 29°C incubator for 22–25 h before dissection for imaging experiments.
Dissect flies in a live imaging medium if performing live-cell imaging.
Clean and wash the testes with live imaging medium during dissection.
Mount testes in the glass bottom dish, add 100–150 μL of live imaging medium, and cover the lid.
Acquire high spatial and temporal resolution images.
Analyze histone incorporation pattern in mitosis using line plot.
Perform quantification of old and new histones in anaphase or telophase GSCs.
Ensure a complete S phase occurs during the recovery period for histone synthesis and incorporation.
Standardize the recovery time to 22-25 hours to allow GSCs to go through a complete cell cycle before entering M phase.
Conduct a 3D quantification of old and new histone inheritance in telophase.
Save raw images as 2D Z-stacks from live-cell imaging for analysis.
Open images on FIJI (ImageJ) software.
Draw the largest freehand circle that fits within the GSC or the SG to define histone-occupied chromatin region.
Process the image to get the gray value of each pixel using "display_pixel_values" plugins.
Determine the sum of the gray values of all pixels in each Z-stack (‘RawIntDen’).
Determine the sum of the gray values of background pixels in each Z-stack (‘RawIntDen’).
Use the same freehand circle to determine the foreground fluorescence signal and the background signal.
For background signal, use the hub region or any negative region where fluorescence tagged protein is not expressed.
Calculate the actual gray values of the histone fluorescent signal pixels for each Z stack by subtracting the gray values of the background signal pixels from the raw signal pixels (Fs = Rs - Bs).
Calculate the total amount of the histone fluorescent signals in the cell by adding the gray values of the fluorescence signal from all Z-stacks.
Calculate the total fluorescence signal in nuclei using the formula Fs (Z1+…+Zn) = [(Rs-Bs)1+…+(Rs-Bs)n].
Determine the actual amount of histone in voxel in GSC-GB pairs and SG1-SG2 pairs in telophase.
Use 15–25 pairs to analyze the total gray value representing the total amount of histone protein in the cell (Voxel=quantification in the volume of the cell).
Calculate the old histone ratio, GSC to GB, and new histone ratio, GSC to GB.
For control, calculate the old histone ratio, SG1 to SG2, and the new histone ratio, SG1 to SG2.
Plot dot plots for all datasets.
Determine mean value and standard error of the mean (SEM).
Calculate statistical significance.
Define asymmetric inheritance of histone if mean value in GSCs is > mean + 1*STD in control SGs.
Define symmetric inheritance of histone if mean value in GSCs is < mean + 1*STD in control SGs.
Cross UASp-FRT-H3-EGFP-PolyA-FRT-H3-mCherry male flies with hs-FLP; nanos-Gal4 female flies.
Maintain the cross at 18°C.
Collect 1–3 day-old adult male flies (F1 progeny).
Heat shock the collected flies in a 37°C water bath for 90 min.
Recover the heat-shocked flies for 22-25 h at 29°C before dissecting them for experiments.
Generate a maximum intensity projection for each GSCs and SGs.
Draw a largest freehand circle that fits within the GSC or the SG to define histone-occupied chromatin area in the nucleus for analysis.
Determine the gray value of each pixel of the image by using "display_pixel_values" plugins using FIJI (ImageJ) software.
Individually scale the images of each GSC or SG nucleus, setting the minimum intensity to 0 and the maximum to 65,535.
Scale raw fluorescence values using the formula: X′ = (X - Min) * 65535 / (Max - Min).
Quantify the fluorescence intensity distribution by monitoring flux at a threshold of 22,937 scaled intensity.
Determine the condensation parameter for old histone H3-enriched regions and new histone H3-enriched regions by calculating the number of pixels above 22,937 threshold intensity.

Measure the relative condensation of old histone H3-enriched regions by calculating the ratio of condensation parameters of new histone H3-enriched regions to old histone H3-enriched regions in prometaphase for GSCs and SGs.
Use 15–25 GSCs and SGs to determine the relative condensation of old histone H3-enriched regions compared to new histone H3-enriched regions.
Generate a dot plot for all datasets.
Determine the mean value and standard error of the mean (SEM) from the data.
Calculate statistical significance of the differences observed.
Compare the mean value of compaction factor in GSCs with the mean + 1*STD in control SGs to define condensation statuses between sister chromatids.
Cross dual color tagged histone (H3, H4 or H2A) fly line with nanos-Gal4 and α-tubulin-GFP fly line.
Grow the progeny at 25°C.
Collect 1-3 day old adult male flies for live cell imaging.
Acquire high spatial and temporal resolution time-lapse movies of GSCs and SGs.
Use telophase cells for quantification.
Save raw images (as 2D Z-stacks) as TIF images from live cell imaging.
Open the image on FIJI (ImageJ) software and draw the largest freehand circle that fits within GSCs or SGs to define histone occupied chromatin region.
Determine the sum of gray values of the fluorescence signal of each pixel in each Z-stack in the image.
Determine the sum of gray values of background pixels in each Z-stack in the image.
Use the same freehand circle to determine the foreground fluorescence signal and the background signal.
For background signal, use the hub region (niche) or any negative region where the fluorescence tag protein is not expressed.
Calculate the actual gray values of the fluorescence signal pixels for each Z stack by subtracting the gray values of the background signal from the raw signal.
Next, calculate the total amount of fluorescence signal in the nuclei by adding the gray values of the fluorescence signal from all Z-stacks.
Use 10–15 GSC-GB pairs and 10–15 SG1-SG2 pairs to calculate the nucleosome density.
Generate a dot plot for all datasets.
Determine the mean value and standard error of the mean (SEM) for the datasets.
Calculate statistical significance for the datasets.
Define asymmetric nucleosome density if the mean value in GSC-GB pairs is > mean + 1*STD in control (SG1-SG2 pairs).
Define symmetric nucleosome density if the mean value in GSC-GB pairs is < mean + 1*STD in control (SG1-SG2 pairs).
